name: cangjie-skill
title_zh: 长内容拆成可执行技能包，一本书变一套动作
tagline_zh: 把书、播客、长视频里的框架和方法论，拆成 Agent 能直接调用的原子技能。不是笔记，是能上手干活的工具。
tagline_en: Turn books, podcasts & courses into atomic skills your agent can actually invoke—not notes, but ready-to-use tools.
desc_en: Distill a book, long-video transcript, podcast, course, or interview into a coherent set of executable skills. Use when the user asks to "拆书" / "蒸馏一本书" / "把 XX 书做成 skill" / "把这个视频/播客/课程蒸馏成 skill" / "turn a book or video into skills" — i.e. wants the frameworks, principles, and methodologies in long-form content extracted into atomic, reusable Claude skills that an agent can invoke in real-world si
why_zh: 它不总结观点，只提取可执行程序：每个技能带触发条件和操作步骤，让知识从「读过」变成「能调用」。
why_en: It skips summaries and extracts executable procedures—each skill with triggers and steps, turning knowledge into invocable.
limit_zh: 只处理长文本输入（书/文稿/字幕），不读 PDF 或音视频文件本身；产物是技能包而非笔记，若你只想要摘要或思维导图。
limit_en: Input must be text (book/transcript/subtitles); won't read PDFs or media files. Outputs skill packs, not summaries/mindmaps—wrong tool for that.
title_en: Distill books & videos into executable skill packs
